1.w: YHWH reigns, let the earth rejoice, let the many shores be glad!

2.w: Cloud and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of His throne.

3.w: A fire goes out before His face, and burns up His adversaries round about.

4.w: His lightnings give light [to] the world; the earth sees, and trembles.

5.w: The mountains are melted like wax from before the face of YHWH, from before the face of the Lord of all the earth.

6.w: The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the peoples see His glory.

7.w: Let all those serving a carved image be put to shame, those boasting in idols! Bow down to Him, all gods!

8.w: Zion hears and is glad; the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of Your judgments, O YHWH.

9.w: For You, O YHWH-Elyon, [are] over all the earth; greatly are You exalted over all gods.

10.w: O lovers of YHWH, hate evil; He preserves the souls of His holy ones; from the hand of the wicked He delivers them.

11.w: Light shines on the righteous, and gladness for the upright of heart.

12.w: Be glad, O righteous ones, in YHWH, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness!
